objects: one complete-card-admitted instant or sorcery with Rebound
state_reads: current legal targets and mandatory costs
costs: the initial spell uses its selected ordinary cost
the Rebound cast pays no mana cost but retains represented mandatory additional costs
timing: the delayed cast happens during resolution of the next-upkeep trigger and ignores ordinary type timing
targets: new targets are chosen for the later cast; no legal target leaves the card exiled
choices: the delayed cast may be accepted or declined
hidden_information: the exiled card and trigger are public
apnap: the delayed trigger joins the ordinary upkeep trigger batch
layers: the stack ability is checked only for the initial successful hand cast
replacement_effects: only successful graveyard-bound resolution is changed to exile; countered spells do not rebound
copy: spell copies and repeated Rebound instances do not create additional represented lifecycles
control_change: the initial spell controller controls the delayed trigger and later cast
zone_change: leaving and returning to exile makes the old delayed trigger stale
source_leaves: the trigger is pinned to the exact exile logical identity

implementation.supported_slice: One intrinsic bare Rebound declaration on a complete instant or sorcery cast from hand, successfully resolved to exile, and offered once from the same exile incarnation at its controller's next upkeep.

known_blockers: granted Rebound and external rebound effects
copied, text-changed, repeated, and incomplete-card forms
replacement or permission interactions outside canonical owners
